note: The bt-api API_VERSION range this bundle's guidance was written against. One claim in this task's own brief did NOT check out: it asserted `EngineSpecDto.account` (`"cash"`/`"margin"`) is 'now described in the submit tools'. Grepped all five skills and their `references/` for `AccountSpec`, the literal strings `"cash"`/`"margin"`, and `EngineSpecDto`/`EngineSpec`/`engine_spec` case-insensitively — the only hits are `references/sdk-surface.md`'s auto-generated type-alias rows for unrelated `bt_model::account::{Account, AccountBalance, AccountKind, AccountId}` structs (SDK re-export paths, not submit-tool guidance) and one line in `charting/SKILL.md` ("the same EngineSpec shape run_backtest takes", no field-level detail). No skill sentence promises or depends on an `account` field; per `bt-api/src/lib.rs`'s own `no bump (2026-08-11, account on the engine spec, #524)` entry, that field never shipped without `rejection_reasons` in any deployed build, so there is no older-server pairing where the bundle's silence on it could go stale either. It does not weaken the raise — (1)-(4) already establish it — but it is not evidence for it, and is recorded here rather than silently dropped so the next reader does not re-derive it. `min` therefore moves from 13 to 14: a server at 13 predates the commits that landed the JSON config lane and the current `export_module!`/schema guidance in bt-mcp, and following this bundle's SKILL.md against it produces refused submissions, not just missing fields.
